<b>Final Audience</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The wish can be acquired from [[Songclave]]'s [[wishwall]] after activating the [[Second Sentinel]] by assembling [[Cogheart]], meeting them (whether they are fighting enemies or resting) at least twice within [[the Citadel]] (or once if the [[Everbloom]] has been acquired), obtaining the [[Conductor's Melody]], and completing at least two of Songclave's wishes, including <i>[[Building Up Songclave]]</i>.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall's location in the Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall in Songclave
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must locate the Second Sentinel within the [[High Halls]], where a small room has opened up. Pins left by the Second Sentinel are scattered across the [[Choral Chambers]] leading to their location, which can be interacted with to track them.

At this location, the Second Sentinel, unsure whether Hornet is affected by the [[Haunting]], asks her to test the strength of her will through a battle. Defeating them completes the wish.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Second Sentinel 03.png!Second Sentinel's location in the High Halls
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Silk Fly 01.png!Second Sentinel in the High Halls
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Reserve Bind.png|link=Reserve Bind|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the wish, the Second Sentinel gives Hornet the [[Reserve Bind]] tool.

{{Clear}}
